description: Low-pass gate in stereo, with a high-pass filter added and CV over everything

params.text: How long the envelope takes to rise once it has been fired
The curve of the rising segment, from logarithmic through straight to exponential
How long the envelope takes to fall
The curve of the falling segment, from logarithmic through straight to exponential
The shortest time the envelope stays open, however brief the trigger that fired it
Pans the envelope between the left and right channels, so one side opens further than the other
Treats any rising edge at GATE as a trigger, rather than holding the envelope open for as long as the gate is held
Multiplies the rise time, the fall time and the minimum gate by ten
Runs the two filters one into the other instead of side by side
Gives the VCA a response linear in amplitude rather than in decibels
How much of the envelope reaches the low-pass cutoff
Attenuverts the CV arriving for that amount
The low-pass cutoff with the envelope closed, which the envelope then opens from
Attenuverts the CV arriving for that cutoff
The slope of the low-pass filter, in poles

The high-pass cutoff with the envelope closed

menu: Rise shape CV — how the SHAPE input acts on the rise shape: Enable, Enable inverted or Disable
Fall shape CV — how the SHAPE input acts on the fall shape: Enable, Enable inverted or Disable
Minimum velocity output gain — the gain a 0V input at VELO leaves, -3dB, -6dB, -12dB, -24dB or -60dB; -60dB closes the gate completely
